witness.note: 074000 identifies the surviving 1522 Jiajing printing; its 1494 preface does not prove an unchanged complete novel in 1494. The later received 120-chapter Mao recension remains distinct.

description: Follows Liu Bei's three visits to Zhuge Liang, the Longzhong plan and its political assumptions, the struggle for Jing and the Changban retreat, exploring strategic counsel, narrative attribution and responsibility for civilians and dependents.
